meta_data.base_class: Retrieve detailed historical information about a <specific holiday>- suitable for querying various cultural celebrations or anniversaries that have historical origins and a specific time range.

tool_template.name: retrieve_<class>_history
tool_template.description: Retrieve detailed historical information about the <class>.

year_range.description: The range of years for which to retrieve historical information about the <class>. Format should be 'YYYY-YYYY'.

language.description: The language in which the information should be provided.

include_cultural_significance.description: Whether to include cultural significance and traditions associated with the <class>.

details_level.description: The level of detail required in the historical information about the <class>. Can be 'summary' or 'detailed'.

region_specific_information.description: Whether to include region-specific historical information about the <class>.

historical_figures.description: Whether to include information about historical figures associated with the <class>.
